title: Claude Subscription
subtitle: Use a Claude Pro/Max subscription through the official browser sign-in.
description: Route Claude models through your Claude Pro/Max subscription, with a quota panel and an egress guard.
signingIn: Waiting for you in the browser…
enterCode: Paste the code shown by the page
quotaEmpty: The usage endpoint reported no limits.
egressProxyMissing: No proxy configured — every request will be refused.
egressProxyInvalid: This proxy value is not a plain http(s) origin.
egressRequire: Refuse when the egress cannot be verified
egressNote: The proxy is mandatory: this route never falls back to a direct connection. The browser step of the sign-in uses your browser's own network settings, which this plugin cannot control.
